subject: Deferred start and incremental GPU allocation for ByteWave reserved commit
messages:
From: Kara O'Neill <kara.oneill@bytewave.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Reserved commit — flexibility on start / ramp?

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. ByteWave is interested in moving to a reserved commit for Dedicated (we like the predictability) but two things are top of mind for procurement:

1) We need a deferred start option — our product launch is Feb 2027, so we'd like the billing/commit to begin in January 2027 but be able to request initial capacity only in March.
2) We want a phased GPU allocation: start small (10% of committed GPUs) for the first 60 days, then 40% and finally full capacity by month 5.

Can Redwood accommodate a 24-month commit with a deferred start and milestone-based ramping? Also need clarity on throughput guarantees and credits if SLAs aren't met during the ramp period.

Kara O'Neill
Head of Infrastructure
ByteWave
[Attachment: product_launch_timeline.pdf (PDF, 98KB)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference>
To: Kara O'Neill <kara.oneill@bytewave.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-15T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Reserved commit — flexibility on start / ramp?

Hi Kara — great to hear you're moving toward a reserve. Short answers up front: yes on deferred start; yes on phased allocation. We have a few standard approaches and one tailored option I think will fit ByteWave:

- Term: 24 months (we can also quote 12/36 but I'll focus on 24 as you mentioned).
- Deferred start: up to a 90-day deferred billing window at no extra cost; beyond that we propose a small ramp fee.
- Phased allocation: we support milestone-based allocation with guaranteed minimum throughput per phase. We typically express guarantees as p50/p95 per-pool throughput targets for the committed GPUs.

I'll loop in Rishi for pricing/discounts and Karthik for legal/procurement language. Can you confirm the exact calendar dates for your launch and whether the 60/40/100 split is fixed? Also, would ByteWave prefer milestone-based billing or invoice-when-capacity-is-provisioned?

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: deferred_start_examples.pdf (PDF, 56KB)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
To: Kara O'Neill <kara.oneill@bytewave.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-15T11:43:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Reserved commit — flexibility on start / ramp?

Hi Kara — thanks, and happy to run numbers. High level pricing terms we can offer for a 24-month reserved commit (GPU pool sizing on A100-class equivalent) depending on ramp start:

- Standard 24-month: 15% list discount off hosted/dedicated baseline.
- Deferred start (<=90 days): same 15% discount, deferred billing with invoice at start date.
- Deferred start (>90 days up to 180 days): 12% discount + one-time staging fee (covers reserved reservation hold).
- Phased allocation (milestone-based): we can apply a pro-rata credit model if availability or p95 throughput misses the agreed milestone SLAs; credit calculation will be tied to percent of affected tokens/throughput during that phase.

We typically require a capacity matrix to size the pool and map p50/p95 throughput guarantees per tenant workload — can you share any representative QPS / concurrency numbers? I attached a sample capacity_matrix.xlsx to show how we map committed GPUs to expected throughput across sequence lengths.

Rishi
Head of Sales, Dedicated Capacity | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: capacity_matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 210KB)]

From: Kara O'Neill <kara.oneill@bytewave.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-16T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Reserved commit — flexibility on start / ramp?

Thanks Rishi — that helps. A few clarifications from our side:

- Launch timing: final launch targeted Feb 15, 2027. We want billing to begin Jan 1, 2027, but initial capacity only provisioned on Mar 1, 2027. So deferred start of 60 days.
- Ramp request: 10% of committed pool on day 1 of provisioning (Mar 1), 40% on day 61, 100% on day 151.
- SLA sensitivity: during ramp we need a clear definition of what counts as an SLA miss (we're primarily concerned about p95 latency and tail throughput at our 99th percentile request sizes). We can accept pro-rata credits but would like a maximum credit cap (e.g., not exceeding 25% of monthly spend for that phase).

Also, procurement asks whether Redwood will permit a one-time start-date change (shift by up to 30 days) if our regulatory audit runs late.

Kara

Date: 2026-11-17T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: ByteWave deferred-start ask (summary & recommended term language)

Team — quick summary and recommended approach for ByteWave (they want the combination of deferred billing + phased GPU allocation + SLA credit cap):

- Proposal: 24-month reserved commit, billing effective Jan 1, 2027 (deferred start agreement). Provisioning window starts Mar 1, 2027. One-time start-date change allowed up to 30 days with written notice (no fee).
- Ramp schedule: 10% (day 0), 40% (day 61), 100% (day 151). Billing will follow invoice schedule based on committed amount; however, we will apply phase-level usage credits if p95 latency or tail throughput guarantees are missed.
- Credit cap: propose max 25% of monthly committed spend in any given ramp phase. If frequent misses occur (>2 phases with misses >10% of requests), we trigger an executive review and remediation plan.
- Pricing: offer 15% discount for 24-month with <=90-day deferred start. If start pushed beyond 90 days but <=180 days, reduce to 12% + staging fee (as Rishi noted).

Action items:
- Rishi: please prepare a clean term sheet with the language above and the capacity mapping (attach capacity_matrix.xlsx).
- Karthik: draft the contractual clause for deferred-start and start-date change (limit = 30 days; staging fee triggers >90 days).

Evelyn
Senior Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
